app.staleSave.title: Someone else changed these files
app.staleSave.body: Since you opened or last saved this project, these files were changed on disk — by a teammate's save in a shared folder, a git pull outside SaiLoR, or a second copy of the project. Nothing has been saved yet.
app.staleSave.overwriteHint: Your version of these files replaces the one on disk. What the other person changed in them is lost.
app.staleSave.discard: Keep theirs, drop my changes to these files
app.staleSave.discardHint: These files stay as they are on disk, and your unsaved edits to them are thrown away. Your edits to other files are still saved.
app.staleSave.combineHint: Merge field by field. A field only one of you changed keeps that change; where you both changed the same field, you choose.
app.staleSave.refusal: These changes can't be combined field by field. {reason} Choose one of the other two.
app.staleSave.laterTitle: You will be asked again the next time you save
app.staleSave.merge.title: Combine with the changes on disk
app.staleSave.merge.intro: You and the version on disk both changed these fields. Everything else has already been combined: a field only one side changed kept that side's value.
app.staleSave.merge.backTitle: Go back to choosing how to save — nothing has been saved yet
app.staleSave.merge.finishTitle: Save the project with the values chosen above

prompt.reviewer.title: This review has {count} reviewers
prompt.reviewer.intro: Every paper here is annotated independently by {count} people. You will see and edit only your own answers — not anyone else's. That is the point: an SLR's reviewers are meant to reach their findings separately, so that where they agree means something.
prompt.reviewer.pick: Pick the reviewer seat you are using for this session. Your selection is remembered only on this machine for this project and is never written to the project file.
prompt.reviewer.consolidation: Consolidation is the pass that comes after. Whoever takes that seat sees everyone's answers side by side, settles the disagreements, and records the project's final result. It is not another opinion — it is the reconciliation of the others.
prompt.reviewer.readyTitle: Every paper has been annotated by all reviewers
prompt.reviewer.notReadyTitle: Papers not yet annotated by every reviewer cannot be compared yet
prompt.reviewer.note: Switch seats from the toolbar whenever you like. Each paper remembers the seat you last read it in and switches back to it when you return, so if you are Reviewer 1 on some papers and Reviewer 2 on others, you only choose once per paper. Press F1 to read Help before choosing.
strict.picker.title: Who are you?
strict.picker.intro: This project uses strict mode. Each person sees only the papers assigned to them. The seat is set for each paper. This choice is remembered only on this computer for this project.
strict.picker.managerTitle: See all papers and seats, and consolidate
strict.bar.switchDirty: Save your changes before you switch to a different person
strict.bar.finishedAll: All your assigned papers are finished
strict.bar.finishTitle: Mark all your assigned papers as finished and save
strict.bar.finishConfirm: Mark your work on all {count} assigned papers as finished and save the project? After the save, only the Manager can reopen the work.
strict.gate.confirm: These persons have not finished this paper: {names}. Open Consolidation anyway?
strict.gate.body: Consolidation opens when all assigned persons have finished this paper.
